filed: 2026-11-03, before the code ran; never edited after the run
question: E76: on Qwen3-1.7B, does teacher training towards a real update (u1, E40 step 10), with a second term in the loss read through masks, keep the decomposition faithful: does the masked term fall with a change placed like the update's and of its size, with all 196 sites masked (B) or under the library's routing (L), against the clean term alone (A)?
rules: experiments/qwen_masked_teacher/rules.py; run against zero denominators, NaN, band-edge ties, a stopped arm and a missing arm in tests/test_qwen_masked_teacher.py before filing
rows: Readings: the first 8 of E74's maths rows at 256 tokens, the same 8 at every reading of every arm, never trained on. Training: maths rows 33-64 and FineWeb evaluation rows 1-32, one of each per step, the same batch order in every arm. The thresholds below are from E72 and E74 on 128 and 32 maths rows; each arm's step-0 reading shows the 8 rows' own value beside them.

definitions.student: Teacher training's student: W0 + change, offsets on about 200 often-on columns per site (`qwen_maps.halves`'s order among columns ever over g 0.01 on the 72 rows of the job), Γ and Δ frozen, the rest of the alive set unmoved
definitions.masks: m = g + (1 - g) u, d ~ U(0, 1) per position and site, g from Γ on W0's clean forward with W0's V, cached per row in bf16 and frozen; fresh per row and step in training, one fixed draw per row at every reading
definitions.routing: B: all 196 sites masked. L: the library's UniformKRouting, k None: at each position k uniform on 1..196, a uniform subset of k sites takes the masked branch, the others output the student's x W'^T (m = 1, d = 1)
definitions.loss: KL(teacher clean || student clean) + 1 x KL(teacher clean || student masked), mean over every position of 2 x 256 tokens; A has the first term alone; Adam at 1e-6, betas 0.9, 0.999, no decay; forwards and backward in TF32 as qwen_teacher.train; readings in full fp32
definitions.i: clean KL(FT || student), mean over every position of the 8 rows
definitions.iii: share of ||change||^2 in blocks 21-27 over the same share of ||dW||^2; NaN with no change to read or a zero denominator
definitions.iv: KL(FT clean || student masked), all 196 sites, whatever the arm trained on, the fixed draw
definitions.dtype_floor: stage 0: |K0 through the arms' path (bf16 components, the cached g) - K0 in fp32| on the 8 rows at seed 74, same draws. Settled in this job
definitions.C_spread: the range of (iv) over control C's readings, its fall when it falls throughout. Settled in this job. Read by the rules only as the band below
definitions.band: the larger of the dtype floor and C's spread; NaN (no verdict of works) when either is unread

expected.at_zero_offsets: the student's masked forward equals W0's: maximum logit gap 0 (stage 0 stops above 1e-4); its gradient reaches dV and dU (each arm's first minutes, a stop)

blind_to.i: a re-implementation of the same behaviour
blind_to.iii: a late change that is still a good map

stage 0.hook_rebuild: E77's amplitude 0.59 and cosine 0.86 rebuilt from the saved vectors, each within 0.005; a miss means something other than the norm, hook suspect. No other threshold on the swaps
stage 0.K0: E74's K0 0.0440 on its 32 rows, seed 74, fp32 components, within 10%
stage 0.share: the cut holds at least 50% of the sum of g; under it, ask the user about the paid card
stage 0.identity: the student's masked forward at zero offsets within 1e-4 of W0's in every logit

stops.C: (iv) at step 100 strictly below step 0: not falling is a gradient bug
stops.A: (i) at step 100 strictly below 0.95 of step 0 (rehearsals read 0.74-0.79)
stops.all arms: any of (i), (ii), (iv) or a training term not finite; masked term's squared gradient on dV or dU zero or not finite
stops.logged, no stop: step time and projected total at step 50; TF32 against fp32 of the masked term on one draw

predictions.works: (i) <= 0.09, the band of placements (E72 u1 T2); (ii) <= 0.94, 1.5 x dW's; (iii) <= 3; and (iv) below arm A's by more than the band
predictions.fails to learn: (iv) within the dtype floor of arm A's at the last step, inclusive. Can stand beside 'not a map'
predictions.else: reported as read, no amendment; 'unread' when a number a verdict needs is NaN or missing
predictions.A: scored on (i)-(iii). If A reads above 0.53 on (i), the clean term is short of steps or columns at this size: B and L are read against A at the same step, so works' (i) clause becomes (i) <= A's and not a map's (i) clause is off
predictions.last step: rules read the last step, 1200; an arm stopped or not finished gets no verdict

B.lean: not a map by (iii), or fails to learn

L.lean: (iii) passes and (iv) barely below A's, read as below by under 10% of A's (iv)

what_each_result_does.B works: D1 has its map on u1; next RL's step 100 on the paid card with the full alive set, user told first
what_each_result_does.B fails, L works: the map holds only when many sites read full weights; D1 stated with that limit; the user decides
what_each_result_does.both fail: the masked term cannot do what ask 24 asked of it on this model; arm A is what is left; back to the user
what_each_result_does.A short: teacher training at 200 columns is too small a test on any arm; bring the paid card to the user with this number

departures_from_vpd_fit: No adversary, though 90% of its reconstruction samples are adversarial; Γ frozen on W0; only U and V of 200 of the alive columns move; no faithfulness term; no hidden-activation terms; Adam at tiny batch; masks from W0's forward, not the student's
not_run: Γ moving with the student; the adversary in the loss; the full alive set; RL's update; fixed masks in the loss; the 67M with masks in its loss; the student under its own masks (E72 read 0.103-0.105 for every state on u1, so it cannot separate anything)
